learning_outcomes.text: Comprehends the sound and structural features/rules of Turkish; gains proficiency in Turkish spoken and written communication.
Knows the definition of language, comprehends the place and importance of language as a social institution in national life, recognizes the link between language-culture and language-thought.
Learns the place of the Turkish language among world languages, recognizes the richness and subtleties of Turkish.
Knows the historical development of the Turkish language.
Knows the current status of the Turkish language, its contemporary dialects and areas of spread.
Gains awareness of language pollution/degeneration issues, knows the factors that threaten/may threaten the existence of Turkish.

syllabus_topics: Definition, Origin and Characteristics of Language
Social Aspect of Language: Its Relation with Society, Culture-Nation, Thought, Emotion and Communication
Types of Language, Types of Language Study, Languages in Terms of Comparison of Developed-Undeveloped
Languages on Earth and Classification of Languages
Historical Periods of the Turkish Language: 1. Old Turkish
Historical Periods of the Turkish Language: 2. Middle Turkish
Historical Periods of the Turkish Language: 3. New Turkish
Current Status and Areas of Spread of the Turkish Language
Current Status and Areas of Spread of the Turkish Language
"Simplification" in the Turkish Language; Current Problems of the Turkish Language
Main Sound Characteristics of the Turkish Language, Ways of Word Formation in the Turkish Language
assessment_rules: The midterm exam accounts for 40% of the final grade, and the final exam accounts for 60%. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate and specified in the academic calendar.
